about: The id each experiment prints under. 'printed' is a ledger: once a folder has printed under an id it keeps it, and no other folder can take it (the editor may hold that page on paper). A new folder prints under its declared id if that is free, otherwise under the next free one, and is added to the ledger by the build. 'held' leaves an experiment out of the print with its reason. (30 and 31 October 2026: three collisions in a day, each fixed by hand, before the ledger.)
